units: <cite ref="Berakhot 34b:2">Ber. 34ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 22b:16">Meg. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ זו פישוט וכ׳</he> prostration means spreading out hands and feet.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:14">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> top <he>לך ה׳</he> before Thee prostration is due; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:1:4">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 43ᵈ</cite> top <cite ref="U02089"><he>שְׁתַּחְוָיָה</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>הִשְׁתַּחֲוָויוֹת</he>, <cite ref="E00941"><he>הִשְׁתַּחֲיָ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 31a:18">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני כריעות וה׳</he> in consequence of his repeated kneelings and prostrations.
